sections.heading: Description
sections.content: The Current Service Blueprint visualizes the end-to-end customer experience and the supporting front- and back-office processes. It maps interactions between customers, employees, and systems to expose service gaps, friction points, and dependency failures. By following the ACE model and 6D methodology, it links customer touchpoints to operational processes, ensuring a unified view of how services are delivered.

sections.heading: Business Value
sections.content: Improves service quality and customer satisfaction by identifying inefficiencies and experience gaps. It enables targeted service enhancements, aligns internal operations with customer expectations, and lays the groundwork for customer-centric transformation.
